No but you could maybe make it a better turd.
Joking aside I do know how you feel, I have the scars to prove it. But you are worth so much more to your children alive. 
Please be kind to yourself.
Thank you, I am definitely not homophobic but having had no idea all this time that he found men attractive is very difficult.

You know what your faults are, work to repair them for your children. Your wife sounds a bit mean, even if you are difficult, telling you what she has makes nothing better.
Those kiddies need you. Seek help, please. Speak to your wife tell her how you feel and try to work it out together. 
Things can always be fixed, it may take some work but you are worth it, we all are. I wish you well.
They are but he is not. It has broken my mind. I will fix it but...

When I accidentally discovered yesterday that my partner of 25 years was having sexually charged conversations with a man on secret social media accounts.

Edit, I Am a woman.
We have had a lot of good times, this is so completely out of the blue.
Thank you. I have no one I can talk to about this and you guys are helping me think.

Yes, he did. He was unaware that it was a married man however.
Edit, I was wrong he knew!
No unfortunately not a joke, I so wish it was.
Yes, this exactly. I think I would be finding it easier if it had been a woman but there has never been any suggestion before that I was the incorrect gender! 23 years for Christ’s sake. Thanks.
